def: The drop in per-language performance when a fixed-capacity model is trained on more languages, because capacity dilution outweighs positive cross-lingual transfer (Conneau et al., 2019).
practice: Hits small models hardest and eases with more capacity; a 2025 study of 1.1B and 3B models trained on up to 400 languages found no significant curse, so its size is debated.
